AGENDA

729 N. AZUSA AVENUE

06:30 P.M. Convene to Regular Meeting of the Azusa Utility Board
Call to Order
Pledge to the Flag
Roll Call
A.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
(Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes maximum time, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's
questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes time.)
B.
UTILITIES DIRECTOR COMMENTS
C.
UTILITY BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS
D.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Approval of the City of Azusa Wildfire Mitigation Plan Update Dated June 15, 2021 Recommendation: 1) Approve the City of Azusa Wildfire Mitigation Plan Update dated June 15, 2021.
D-1.1. Approve City of Azusa Update Wildfire Mitigation Plan
D-1.2. Azusa Wildfire Mitigation Plan Update June 2021
E.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes of the Utility Board Meeting on May 24, 2021 Recommendation: 1) Approve Minutes as written.
E-1.1. Utility Board Meeting Minutes 05-24-2021
2.
Approval of the 2020 Power Source Disclosure Report Recommendation: 1) Approve the 2020 Power Source Disclosure Annual Report.
E-2.1. Approval of the 2020 Power Source Disclosure Report
E-2.2. 2020 Power Source Disclosure Annual Report
3.
Approval of the Temporary Leasing of Water Rights to the San Gabriel Valley Water Company Recommendation: 1) Approve water rights lease agreements with the San Gabriel Valley Water Company; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute such water rights leases, pursuant to Utility Board Resolution 09-C69.
E-3.1. Water Rights Lease SGVWC
E-3.2. Lease of Water Rights Agreement - San Gabriel Valley Water Company
E-3.3. Resolution No. 09-C69
4.
Approve Second Amendment to the Agreement for Mainteance Services with General Pump Company for Water Well and Booster Pump Maintenance Services Recommendation: 1) Approve the Second Amendment to the Agreement for Maintenance Services (“Second Amendment”) with General Pump Company; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the Second Amendment, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, on behalf of the City.
E-4.1. Approve Second Amendment of General Pump MSA
E-4.2. General Pump Agreement for Maintenance Services
E-4.3. Second Amendment to Agreement for Maintenance Services
5.
Approve Second Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Northstar Chemical to Provide Water Treatment Chemical and Equipment Services Recommendation: 1) Approve the Second Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement (“Second Amendment”) with Northstar Chemical, as a DBA of Pacific Star Chemical, in an amount not to exceed $187,000, in accordance with Azusa Municipal Code Section 2-517(a)(24); and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the Second Amendment, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, on behalf of the City.
E-5.1. Approve Second Amendment to PSA with Northstar Chemical
E-5.2. Second Amendment to Professional Services Agreement
E-5.3. Northstar Chemical Proposal
E-5.4. Univar-USA Quote
6.
Approve Grant of Easement and Authorize the Record Thereof for the Electric Facilities Installed on Private Property from Property Owner for Site Address 407 S. Motor Avenue, Azusa, CA 91702 Recommendation: 1) Certificate of Acceptance of Grant of Permanent Easement for Electric utility purposes from property owner for site address 407 S. Motor Avenue in the City of Azusa; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-UB-09; and 3) Authorize the City Clerk to file said easement documents with the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
E-6.1. Approve Grant of Easement - 407 S Motor Avenue
E-6.2. Resolution No. 2021-UB-09
E-6.3. Grant of Permanent Easement
F.
STAFF REPORTS/COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Annual Adjustment of Replacement Water Cost Adjustment Factor Recommendation: 1) Receive and file this information report.
F-1.1. Annual Adjustment of Replacement Water Cost Adjustment Factor for FY 21-22
F-1.2. RWCAF Replacement Water Cost Adjustment Factor Worksheet FY21-22
G.
VERBAL COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Power Supply Update
2.
Water Supply Update
H.
CLOSED SESSION
1.
None
I.
ADJOURNMENT
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting or time when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
In compliance with Government Code Section 54957.5, agenda materials are available for inspection by members of the public at the following locations: Azusa City Clerk's Office - 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa City Library - 340 West Fifth Street, and Azusa Light & Water - 729 N. Azusa Avenue, Azusa CA.
